contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Runs the Z Code game workshop and directed this production.

contributions.name: Z Code
contributions.summary: Designed the orchard match-3 (constrained swaps, gravity, bounded cascades), tuned all 12 levels with greedy and simulated-human players, implemented the pure engine, the daylight-orchard interface (EN/FR/ES), the drag-and-tap controls, the audio and the tests, and verified the published game in the public reader.
